newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi's Savola Co 96 net profit rises 39 percent.
newsitem.headline: Saudi's Savola Co 96 net profit rises 39 percent.

text.p: Savola Company of Saudi Arabia, the kingdom's biggest food group, said on Wednesday it posted a 140 million riyal ($37.3 million) net profit in 1996.
A company statement said net profits climbed 39 percent from the previous year's 101 million riyals. Total sales in 1996 rose by 317 million riyals to more than 1.5 billion riyals.
Savola, traded on the Saudi stock market, is the country's main supplier of cooking oil.
It is the leading investor in a joint Saudi-British sugar refinery, part of a programme to offset British military sales to the kingdom. ($1=3.75 riyals)
